svg.title: The order for checking input and output when you cannot hear sound in a video meeting
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
The order for checking input and output when you cannot
hear sound in a video meeting
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-30
First identify which direction is
blocked
Ask the other person, “Can you hear my voice?”
and decide what to check based on the answer.
Test the input device in Windows
Microsoft support documentation explains how to
go to Settings > System > Sound, select a
microphone under Input, and open its device…
Check microphone permissions
On Windows’ Privacy & security > Microphone
screen, check whether Microphone access and Let
apps access your microphone are turned on.
Select devices in the meeting app
In the meeting app’s settings, select the
microphone and speaker separately.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
